context:
Goal: a fix to a guard after review round 3 cannot open a safety hole unseen.
Problem (rule): roles-review-cap-three runs the net-value test after round 3; 203 a adds one fresh check of a later fix, and does not say whether that check repeats the test.
Based on (ruling): your pick 203 a (22:24 CST).
Departs from: main, which has no fix check — the lane would record "no": the fix check is the review.

options.gain: A fix lands after one short read.
options.how: The fresh reviewer reads only the fix and finds no blocker; no net-value test.
options.label: No: the fix check is the review
options.lose: A fix that opens a small hole is judged only by the one reader.

options.gain: Each guard fix is weighed the same way.
options.how: The fresh reviewer also weighs holes closed against holes opened, against main.
options.label: Yes: the fix check repeats the net-value test
options.lose: A longer read on each fix.

title: When a fix after the last review edits a guard or check, is the net-value test owed again?
why: Recommended: a. The fix check reads only the fix, so the hole it could open is in plain view.
